description: Positive control: check that the docking scan localizes the NDH-2 interface on its known C-terminal amphipathic helices, and poll the Foldseek search
code:
import os, json, time, numpy as np, pandas as pd, requests
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
OUT=os.getcwd(); exec(open(os.path.join(OUT,'crty_lib.py')).read(), globals())
S=requests.Session(); S.headers.update({'User-Agent':'Mozilla/5.0'})
tk=json.load(open(os.path.join(OUT,'foldseek_ticket.json')))['id']
st=S.get('https://search.foldseek.com/api/ticket/%s'%tk,timeout=60).json()
print("foldseek:",st)

# NDH-2 positive control: does the method put the interface on the known C-terminal amphipathic helices?
txt=S.get('https://files.rcsb.org/download/5NA1.pdb',timeout=120).text
at=parse_pdb(txt,chain='A'); a_=sasa(at); mf=membrane_fit(at,a_,ndir=300,step=1.0)
X=np.array([[q['x'],q['y'],q['z']] for q in at]); dep=mf['d']-(X@mf['normal'])
res=residues_from(at,a_)
rows=[]
for r in res:
    ds=[mf['d']-(np.array([q['x'],q['y'],q['z']])@mf['normal']) for q,s in r['atoms'] if s>1.0]
    rows.append(dict(resi=r['resi'],aa=r['aa'],depth=max(ds) if ds else -99,
                     asa_in=sum(s for q,s in r['atoms'] if s>1.0 and (mf['d']-(np.array([q['x'],q['y'],q['z']])@mf['normal']))>0)))
N=pd.DataFrame(rows); last=N[N.resi>=N.resi.max()-55]
print("5NA1 chain A: residues %d-%d"%(N.resi.min(),N.resi.max()))
print("  buried ASA total %.0f A2; contributed by the last 55 residues: %.0f A2 (%.0f%%)"%(
    N.asa_in.sum(), last.asa_in.sum(), 100*last.asa_in.sum()/N.asa_in.sum()))
top=N.sort_values('depth',ascending=False).head(15)
print("  deepest residues:", ', '.join('%s%d(%.1f)'%(a,r,d) for a,r,d in zip(top.aa,top.resi,top.depth)))
# truncation control on NDH-2
cut=N.resi.max()-55
at2=[q for q in at if q['resi']<cut]; a2=sasa(at2); mf2=membrane_fit(at2,a2,ndir=300,step=1.0)
print("  5NA1 full  dG/1000A2 = %.2f ; with C-terminal %d residues removed = %.2f"%(
    1000*mf['dG']/a_.sum(), N.resi.max()-cut+1, 1000*mf2['dG']/a2.sum()))

fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(12,4))
D=pd.read_csv(os.path.join(OUT,'crtY_residue_membrane_depth.csv'))
for a,dfr,ttl,c in [(ax[0],D,'CrtY P21687 AlphaFold model','#27ae60'),(ax[1],N,'NDH-2 5NA1 chain A (known monotopic flavoprotein)','#c0392b')]:
    a.fill_between(dfr.resi,0,dfr.depth.clip(lower=0),color=c,alpha=.8)
    a.plot(dfr.resi,dfr.depth,lw=.6,color='#34495e'); a.axhline(0,color='k',lw=.8)
    a.set_xlabel('residue'); a.set_ylabel('depth below fitted membrane surface (A)'); a.set_title(ttl,fontsize=10)
plt.suptitle('The same scan puts the membrane interface on the C-terminal helices in both proteins',fontsize=11)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
